summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 interim financial report. The filing includes standard quarterly results, balance sheet items, share-based compensation plans, convertible senior notes, and a share repurchase program. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign is present. The disclosure is routine for a foreign private issuer reporting under IFRS. No deal terms or strategic actions are announced. The filing is not a special situation, and no further analysis or risk-arb consideration is warranted.
